verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 runs agent code in an isolated cloud computer rather than on the developer's own VM or workstation. Supporting containment controls include outbound network policy, credential injection that keeps raw secrets out of the sandbox, protocol controls, hard TTL deletion, and a signed audit ledger. missing for 10: documentation of the isolation mechanism (e.g. microVM or kernel-level isolation), explicit security guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
